name: punch-camera-device-20
description: Sample 20 real punch camera actions across desktop, tablet, and phone landscape viewports while preserving zoom, orientation, visibility, and geometry clearance.

args.code: local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') pcall(function() S:StopSimulationAsync() end) task.wait(1) return true

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') local n='VQC Camera Desktop 1366x768' local id for _,x in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do if S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(x).Name==n then id=x break end end local c={Name=n,Width=1366,Height=768,PixelDensity=96,DeviceForm=Enum.DeviceForm.Desktop} if id then S:UpdateDeviceAsync(id,c) else id=S:CreateDeviceAsync(c) end S:SetDeviceAsync(id) S:SetScalingModeAsync(Enum.DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.FitToWindow) task.wait(.3) local r=S:GetResolutionAsync() return H:JSONEncode({active=S:GetDeviceAsync()==id,width=r.X,height=r.Y})

local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke('Reset') c:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=6000,WallLevel=99,Depth=0,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0}) local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local r=p.Character.HumanoidRootPart r.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero r.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-2,3,-27),Vector3.new(-2,3,-240)) p:SetAttribute('LastWallHit',0) return true

local function compactCameraDeviceDecision(result,metricsValid,followActive,viewport)
 local summary={metricsValid=metricsValid,cameraDeviceContractValid=metricsValid,resultType=type(result)}
 local values=type(result)=='table' and result or {}
 local numberKeys={'actions','inside','maxBack','visibleRatio','clearRatio','readableRatio','settledClearRatio','settledReadableRatio','maxStep','maxCorrectionStep','maxEscapeStep','unresolvedSafetyFrames','physicalUnresolvedFrames','zoomDelta','angle','lead','selectedDistance','finishDistance','configuredOrbit','userOrbitDistance','overlapEscapes','sampledFrames','settledSamples','transientLineOfSightFrames','longestObscuredRun','lastGuardAge','maxGuardPublishedTravelPerCycle','maxGuardEscapeTravelPerCycle','maxGuardPublishedWritesPerCycle','maxInheritedRootStep','sampleMaxStep','teleportRebaseCount'}
 for _,key in ipairs(numberKeys)do local value=values[key] if value~=nil then summary[key]=type(value)=='number' and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge and value or ('invalid_'..type(value)) end end
 for _,key in ipairs({'valid','visualValid','initialOrbitSettled','settleTimedOut','handoffActive','geometryClamped'})do local value=values[key] if value~=nil then if type(value)=='boolean'then summary[key]=value else summary[key]='invalid_boolean'end end end
 for _,key in ipairs({'type','mode','reason','lastGuardPhase'})do local value=values[key] if value~=nil then summary[key]=type(value)=='string' and string.sub(value,1,96) or ('invalid_'..type(value))end end
 local reasons={} if type(values.visualFailureReasons)=='table'then for index=1,math.min(5,#values.visualFailureReasons)do local value=values.visualFailureReasons[index]if type(value)=='string'then table.insert(reasons,string.sub(value,1,64))end end end summary.visualFailureReasons=table.concat(reasons,',')
 -- The producer's validity remains authoritative; these are immediate readbacks,
 -- without a yield or a second camera action after the measured run.
 if type(followActive)=='boolean'then summary.followActiveObserved=followActive else summary.followActiveObserved='unavailable'end
 summary.viewportWidth=viewport and viewport.X or 0 summary.viewportHeight=viewport and viewport.Y or 0
 local samples=values.unresolvedSafetySamples local sample=type(samples)=='table' and samples[1]
 if type(sample)=='table'then
  for _,key in ipairs({'camera','root','guardPhase'})do if type(sample[key])=='string'then summary['physicalFirst_'..key]=string.sub(sample[key],1,96)end end
  for _,key in ipairs({'punch','guardAge','renderAge','overlapCount'})do if type(sample[key])=='number'and sample[key]==sample[key]and math.abs(sample[key])<math.huge then summary['physicalFirst_'..key]=sample[key]end end
  local part=type(sample.parts)=='table' and sample.parts[1]if type(part)=='table' and type(part.name)=='string'then summary.physicalFirst_part=string.sub(part.name,1,128)end
 end
 return summary
end
local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local result=g.PunchWallClientAutomation:Invoke('__RunCamera',8) local metricsValid=type(result)=='table' and result.valid==true and result.visualValid==true and result.actions==8 and result.initialOrbitSettled==true and result.settleTimedOut~=true and result.inside==0 and (result.maxBack or math.huge)<.5 and (result.visibleRatio or 0)>=.9 and (result.clearRatio or 0)>=.55 and (result.readableRatio or 0)>=.65 and (result.settledClearRatio or 0)>=.9 and (result.settledReadableRatio or 0)>=.9 and result.type=='Custom' and result.mode=='CustomPreserved' local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera local diagnostics=compactCameraDeviceDecision(result,metricsValid,g:GetAttribute('PunchCameraFollowActive'),camera and camera.ViewportSize) local encoded=H:JSONEncode(diagnostics) assert(#encoded<3900,'camera decision summary exceeds bound') return encoded
